t: Students Face The World's Toughest Exam
d: In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged. With his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption, fighting to save his loved ones and ignite a revolution.

t: Bully Doesn't Know Girl Has a Huge Secret
d: Maggie bullies Kelly, unaware she has leukemia. After her insults force Kelly out of the school play, Maggie learns the truth. Horrified, she brings the performance to Kelly's hospital room, proving that kindness matters and everyone faces battles.

After a vivid nightmare of robot teachers, Zoe and her friends plot to oust their strict English teacher, Mrs. Bryson. Their pranks backfire when AI robots replace the faculty, causing chaos until the students unite to expose the corrupt principal and bring back their beloved teacher.

Mischievous teen Danny's pranks land him in a reform camp that secretly brainwashes kids. He uncovers the truth with a friend, escapes, and exposes the corrupt doctor, ultimately finding redemption and repairing his family relationships.

t: Student Takes IQ Serum To Impress Girl
d: Chad, a lazy law student, uses a "genius serum" to ace exams and impress a girl. When the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts and embrace hard work, ultimately finding true success.

t: Students Face The World's Toughest Exam
d: In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged. With his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption, fighting to save his loved ones and ignite a revolution.

t: Rival Crews Face Off In School
d: After repeated losses, a karate dojo's sensei quits, leaving Joel and his teammates hopeless. An "old" sensei teaches them inner focus, transforming them into champions who defeat their rivals and discover true strength.

t: Kung Fu Master Saves The Day
d: A dedicated teacher uses empathy to connect with troubled students with difficult pasts. When faced with budget cuts and a potential firing, his students' newfound academic success, fueled by his influence, saves the school and secures his job.

Antwan, a struggling teen, is drawn to drug dealing but finds an unlikely mentor in his English teacher, Mr. Singh. Through poetry, Antwan expresses his hardships, winning a competition and choosing a new path over crime.

Terrorists hijack Yasmine's plane, but she, a seemingly demure teacher, neutralizes them. Starting a new life teaching unruly high schoolers, Yasmine finds herself entangled in a drug operation tied to a mayoral candidate, forcing her to use her past skills to protect her students.

t: Kung Fu Master Helps Teens In School
d: Malic, a hardened teen, is trapped in a gang lifestyle by his brother. A caring teacher, Mr. Wang, uncovers Malic's past trauma and helps him find a new path, inspiring Malic to help his brother escape the cycle of violence.

Benji, a bullied teen, learns martial arts for self-defense. He uses his skills in an underground fight club for money, but guided by his master's wisdom, he chooses to fight for justice, helping his mom and a neighbor escape abusive situations.

Bullied orphan Fletcher, inspired by Jackie Chan, learns martial arts from a kind dojo owner, Daniel. When his estranged biological father, a powerful politician, reappears seeking an endorsement, Fletcher exposes his past, saving Daniel's dojo and launching his own career.
